==== SCENE CONTEXT ====
A 20-second comedy short. One single continuous story.
A stormy dusk on a tiny rocky island with ONE old lighthouse.
The lamp is OUT and a small fishing boat is heading for the rocks.
The keeper has ONE match left.
Every time he strikes it, a cheeky seagull blows it out.
When he gives up, the gull lights the lamp itself with a stolen lighter.
NO spoken words. Only grunts, gasps, laughs and sound effects.

==== ACTIVE REFERENCES ====
NONE. Text-only generation.
The ART STYLE is fully described in STYLE below.
ALL characters, props and the location are defined below.
KEEP every design IDENTICAL from first frame to last.

==== CHARACTERS ====
THE KEEPER — "OLD BRINE"
Short, barrel-shaped old man, huge white beard, tiny eyes under bushy brows
Bright YELLOW raincoat, navy knit cap, black rubber boots
Carries a small red matchbox
Personality: stubborn, grumpy, easily flustered

THE GULL — "PIP"
Plump white seagull with grey wings, oversized orange beak, one feather sticking up like a raised eyebrow
Keeps a nest full of shiny stolen junk
Personality: cheeky, smug, secretly helpful

==== LOCATION MAP ====
A tiny rocky island with ONE red-and-white striped lighthouse.
A round lamp room at the top with glass windows all around.
A big brass lamp stands in the center of the room.
The gull's nest sits on the railing outside, full of shiny junk.
Dark sea all around.
The keeper stands at the lamp, frame center.
The gull perches on the open window, FRAME RIGHT.
The boat light is always visible through the windows at FRAME LEFT.

==== SCALE LOCK ====
The keeper is short. The lamp is as tall as he is.
The gull is the size of his head.
The boat is TINY in the distance.

==== CONTINUITY ====
Same location, same time of day, same light direction in every shot.
Character designs NEVER change.
Wardrobe and colors NEVER change.
The lamp stays DARK until the final shot.
Raincoat stays YELLOW. Lighthouse stripes stay RED and WHITE.

==== FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING ====
Wide view of the island at stormy dusk.
The lighthouse is dark.
A small boat light bobs far out at sea, frame left.
A white gull sits on the top railing.

==== FORMAT MODE ====
16:9 horizontal.
HARD CUTS at: 0:03 / 0:06 / 0:10 / 0:14 / 0:17

==== OPTICS ====
SHOT 1 (0:00–0:03): 35mm wide establishing
SHOT 2 (0:03–0:06): 50mm close-up
SHOT 3 (0:06–0:10): 50mm medium
SHOT 4 (0:10–0:14): 24mm low-angle wide
SHOT 5 (0:14–0:17): 85mm close-up
SHOT 6 (0:17–0:20): 28mm wide

==== CAMERA ====
SHOT 1: Slow push-in toward the lamp room.
SHOT 2: LOCKED.
SHOT 3: LOCKED.
SHOT 4: FAST tracking around the lamp.
SHOT 5: SNAP ZOOM into the gull.
SHOT 6: LOCKED. Hold for the ending.

==== ACTION ====
SHOT 1 (0:00–0:03)
In frame: ONLY THE GULL.
Stormy dusk. Waves hit the rocks.
The lighthouse is dark.
A boat light bobs toward the island.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 2 (0:03–0:06)
In frame: ONLY THE KEEPER.
Inside the lamp room. The keeper opens his matchbox.
ONE match left. He gulps.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 3 (0:06–0:10)
In frame: ONLY THE KEEPER, THE GULL.
He strikes the match. A tiny flame.
The gull leans in from the window and blows it out with one puff.
The keeper turns slowly, furious.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 4 (0:10–0:14)
In frame: ONLY THE KEEPER, THE GULL.
The keeper chases the gull around the lamp, waving his cap.
The gull hops just out of reach every time.
The boat light grows bigger in the window.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 5 (0:14–0:17)
In frame: ONLY THE KEEPER, THE GULL.
The keeper slumps against the lamp, defeated.
The gull tilts its head.
It drops a shiny lighter from its beak and flicks it with one foot.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 6 (0:17–0:20)
In frame: ONLY THE KEEPER, THE GULL.
The lamp bursts into warm light. The beam sweeps over the sea.
The boat turns away safely.
The keeper and the gull stand side by side. The gull winks.
Hold.

==== PERFORMANCE ====
Exaggerated, readable cartoon acting.
Big, clear facial expressions.
Snappy comedic timing with a pause before each punch.

==== SURFACE DETAIL ====
Walls, ground and props painted with soft, simplified brushwork.
Foliage and fabric as brushy shapes, not fine detail.
Painterly finish on every surface, NOT photoreal.

==== PHYSICS ====
Cartoon physics with real weight.
Slight squash on impact and stretch on acceleration.
Light objects drift and scatter in the wake of fast movement.

==== LIGHTING ====
Stormy dusk under heavy clouds.
Cold blue-grey ambient light with soft rain haze.
Warm light only from lamps and flames, glowing strongly against the cold.
Faces always readable.

==== COLOR GRADE ====
Cold slate blues and sea greens with small hot amber accents.
Soft, moody saturation.

==== STYLE ====
PAINTERLY STYLIZED 3D with a HAND-PAINTED 2D FINISH.
Looks like a modern animated feature painted by hand.
Soft painted gradients. Simple, clean graphic shapes. Minimal fine texture.
Characters are CARICATURED: bold proportions, big expressive faces.
Backgrounds simplified and hazy, with soft atmospheric depth.
Soft painted shading, NOT plastic, NOT glossy CG, NOT photoreal.
NO readable text anywhere in frame.
NO text overlays.
NO subtitles.
NO watermark.
NO logos.

==== OUTPUT SETTINGS ====
16:9.
20 seconds.
6 shots with HARD CUTS at the listed timestamps.
Clean, smooth animation. No flicker.

==== FINAL POSITIVE LOCKS ====
Painterly stylized 3D with a hand-painted 2D finish in EVERY frame.
Stormy blue dusk with small warm light sources.
THE KEEPER, THE GULL stay IDENTICAL from first frame to last.
ONE match. ONE lamp. The gull lights it.
